description: Forwards one event to the session instance's observe(). Fill only the fields the session's kind uses (see list_signals): herd-phase / activity-phase / vote-brigading / herd-tightness use { identity, ts } (vote-brigading also takes accountCreatedTs); seat-occupancy and room-guard use { type, identity, ts, accountCreatedTs? }; room-hop uses { identity, room, ts }; reconnect-storm uses { source, kind, ts }. ts is a millisecond timestamp. Returns the library's observation object (e.g. { status, counted }). Feed ONE homogeneous stream per session.

accountCreatedTs.description: seat-occupancy / room-guard / vote-brigading: account creation time in ms, when known.

source.description: reconnect-storm only: session/account key - never an IP address.

type.description: seat-occupancy / room-guard only: the seat-lifecycle event type.

name: observe
title: Feed one event into a signal session
